claims.text: Without a named reader, a document tends to list everything the writer knows; write a one-sentence purpose (reader + what they must be able to do) first and move or cut content that does not serve it.

Precision comes from naming the exact file, command or value the reader needs, not from using more technical terms; clean code does not tell a newcomer which folder to open or which command starts the system.
